verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents webhooks as automated messages sent to your server for account events such as payment lifecycle, balance and dispute changes. They are HMAC-signed, can be configured via the Dashboard or the API, can be resent, and can also be delivered to Amazon EventBridge, so programmatic consumers can register and receive outbound callbacks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery and reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks are automated messages that Checkout.com sends your server when events related to your account occur. For example, payment lifecycle activity, changes to balances, or progress on disputes.
